title: Spark OES-512 BioSignal Explorer: an independent prototype for explainable 512-channel biosignal monitoring in the browser
description:
Spark OES-512 BioSignal Explorer is a single self-contained HTML page (no CDN, no external fonts, no network requests, no backend, no AI API) by Spark AI NLP for interface and concept testing of explainable 512-channel monitoring.

Score contract. A synthetic frame of 512 values is split into 16 blocks of 32. Each block is scored with S = 0.45·max|x| + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·mean|x| and alerts when S ≥ threshold (default 0.50, adjustable). Missing data (NaN) triggers human review and is never scored; non-finite or non-numeric values are rejected the same way. This is the same block score as in oes-resilience and oes512q-latch.

Contents. 512-channel heatmap, per-block score bars, five seeded deterministic synthetic scenarios (Normal, Local anomaly, Drift, Global disturbance, Missing data), an explainability panel, a human-review warning state, JSON export, CSV import, a rule-based plain-English explainer, an in-page self-test, Node tests that execute the page's single score block, and a forbidden-terms scan in CI.

Limits. Evidence: SYNTHETIC only. Independent research prototype. Not a medical device; not diagnostic; not for treatment, patient care or clinical decision-making; not clinically validated. Not affiliated with any external company, clinic, lab or medical organization.
